title: Subarray with k different integers
stepTitle: Sliding Window & Two Pointer Combined Problems
category: Sliding Window & Two Pointer Combined Problems
problemStatement: Solve “Subarray with k different integers” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Hard Problems).
intuition: "Subarray with k different integers" fits two pointers / sliding window when the window condition is monotonic: expand right, shrink left.

approaches.title: Brute subarrays
Optimal sliding window
approaches.idea: Maintain a running state while moving L/R.
approaches.code:
def solve(a, k):
    left = 0
    total = 0
    best = 0
    for right, x in enumerate(a):
        total += x
        while left <= right and total > k:  # adapt invariant
            total -= a[left]
            left += 1
        best = max(best, right - left + 1)
    return best
approaches.whyWorks: Each index moves at most once as left and once as right.

commonMistakes: Using window when the condition is not monotonic
patternRecognition: Longest/shortest contiguous segment under a constraint
